_about: Adam's Logos purchase 'Classic Commentaries and Studies on the General and Pastoral Epistles (16 vols)' (receipt June 2019), its titles as listed on logos.com read 2026-11-03, each found as a pre-1931 Internet Archive scan and its title page read (where only the catalogue was read, the row says so). One shelf for the bundle because its authors mostly have one book each; works already on another shelf are not repeated (listed under _excluded). Internet Archive OCR, raw. All published before 1931, so US public domain. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A. No uids minted.

ccg-gloag-catholic: Introduction to the Catholic Epistles, by Paton J. Gloag (catalogue: Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1887)
ccg-sumner-general-epistles: A Practical Exposition of the General Epistles of James, Peter, John, and Jude, in the Form of Lectures, by John Bird Sumner (London: J. Hatchard, 1840)
ccg-moorehead-catholic: Outline Studies in the New Testament: Catholic Epistles, James, I and II Peter, I, II, III John, and Jude, by William G. Moorehead (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1908, 1910)
ccg-cone-hebrews-pastorals: The Epistles to the Hebrews, Colossians, Ephesians, and Philemon; the Pastoral Epistles; the Epistles of James, Peter, and Jude, International Handbooks to the New Testament, by Orello Cone (catalogue: New York: G. P. Putnam's Sons, 1901)
ccg-boddington-general: The Epistles of St. James, St. Peter, St. John, & St. Jude, Explained in Simple and Familiar Language, by G. B. [Gracilla Boddington] (London: James Nisbet, 1852)
ccg-lillie-2peter-revelation: The Second Epistle of Peter, the Epistles of John and Judas, and the Revelation, translated from the Greek on the basis of the Common English Version, with notes, by John Lillie (catalogue: New York: American Bible Union, 1854)
ccg-mitchell-hebrews-general: Hebrews and the General Epistles, The Westminster New Testament, by A. F. Mitchell (London: Andrew Melrose; catalogue date 1911)
ccg-hillard-pastorals: The Pastoral Epistles of St. Paul: The Greek Text, with Commentary, by A. E. Hillard (London: Rivingtons, 1919)
ccg-glasgow-general: The General Epistles: Studies in the Letters of James, Peter, John and Jude, by Samuel McPheeters Glasgow (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1928)

_excluded.ccg-held: Already on other shelves: B. H. Carroll's Pastoral Epistles (b-h-carroll), Livermore's Hebrews to Revelation (abiel-abbot-livermore)
